title: The Choir of Cold Spring
author: Lena Halloran
blurb: Silas Winterbourne, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the well refills.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
